descriptions.list-append/10: Append a new editable two-field object to the list and commit once per append (adapted from B1.8; objects replace upstream's numbers).
descriptions.edit+encode/10: Capture a version, commit one count edit, encode its incremental update; verify all encoded packets on a peer outside timing.
descriptions.delta-roundtrip/10: Version-vector capture + edit + delta encoding + peer import + peer count read; synchronous CPU-only, without transport or acknowledgement.
descriptions.delta-roundtrip/1000: Version-vector capture + edit + delta encoding + peer import + peer count read; synchronous CPU-only, without transport or acknowledgement.
descriptions.initial-load+materialize/10: Construct an empty replica, import an initial state and materialize a detached JSON view. Export is prepared outside timing; cleanup is outside timing.
descriptions.initial-load+materialize/1000: Construct an empty replica, import an initial state and materialize a detached JSON view. Export is prepared outside timing; cleanup is outside timing.
descriptions.offline-merge/100-per-peer: Two initialized peers make 100 committed offline edits each; time vector capture, two-way delta encode/import and materialization. Edits are outside timing.
descriptions.upstream-map-conflict/16-peers: Adapted B3.1: 16 peers sharing a baseline concurrently update one map key; time importing all deltas and materializing one peer. Setup/encoding and a reference merge are outside timing.
descriptions.proxy-overhead/read-count: Same cached nested field, native API versus the Pulsify pipeline bypassing proxies versus the public proxy.
descriptions.proxy-overhead/mutate-history-0: Native json-joy versus identical Pulsify commit/native-journal pipeline with and without proxy traps; no encoding during local writes, encoded rows are verified identical after export.
descriptions.proxy-overhead/mutate-history-1000: Native json-joy versus identical Pulsify commit/native-journal pipeline with and without proxy traps; no encoding during local writes, encoded rows are verified identical after export.
descriptions.proxy-overhead/mutate-history-5000: Native json-joy versus identical Pulsify commit/native-journal pipeline with and without proxy traps; no encoding during local writes, encoded rows are verified identical after export.
